verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent along X (base length)
Overall bounding-box extent along Y (common width of base and upright)
Overall bounding-box extent along Z (base thickness + upright height)
verification_targets.notes: Assumes upright of UPRIGHT_HEIGHT_Z=60 stands on top of BASE_THICKNESS_Z=5 base plate; TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z = 5 + 60 = 65. If the separate L-leg interpretation (leg measured from outer corner) applies, nominal would be 60.

verification_targets.description: Base and upright form one connected solid with no disjoint lumps
Closed manifold mesh with no open edges or self-intersections
verification_targets.notes: All holes must be fully penetrating so the shell remains closed.

functional_requirements: Bracket MUST be watertight (single, closed, manifold solid).
All overall dimensions MUST match the stated values within +/-0.5 mm.
Base must provide two mounting through-holes to accept 6 mm fasteners.
Upright must provide one through-hole for a 6 mm fastener, 10 mm below the top edge.
Load-bearing L-bracket geometry: base and upright joined to transmit load through the corner.
special_features: The base plate and the upright MUST form a single connected solid joined at their shared corner, with no gap or separation between them.
All three holes MUST be true through-holes that fully penetrate the material.

The two base holes (dia BASE_HOLE_DIA) MUST be centered at X=+BASE_HOLE_POS_X and X=-BASE_HOLE_POS_X, Y=BASE_HOLE_POS_Y, i.e. 10 mm in from each end of the base and centered across the width, and MUST be drilled along the Z axis through BASE_THICKNESS_Z.

The upright hole (dia UPRIGHT_HOLE_DIA) MUST be drilled along the X axis through the upright thickness (UPRIGHT_THICKNESS_X), centered at Y=UPRIGHT_HOLE_POS_Y and at Z=UPRIGHT_HOLE_POS_Z (10 mm below the top face), NOT along Z.
The entire part MUST be symmetric about the XZ plane (Y=0): all holes and features mirror about Y=BASE_HOLE_POS_Y=0.
The upright MUST be located at the +X end of the base with its outer face at X=UPRIGHT_OUTER_FACE_X and inner face at X=UPRIGHT_INNER_FACE_X.
All hole axes MUST be perpendicular to the face they penetrate (base holes along Z, upright hole along X).
Outer faces of the base and upright MUST be planar and mutually perpendicular (90-degree L profile).
cad_brief.user_request_raw:
Read the following part request and produce a formal CAD brief that captures every stated dimension, feature, and constraint without adding or omitting requirements.

Part request: "Make an L-bracket from 5 mm thick aluminum. The base is 80 mm long and 40 mm wide. The upright is 60 mm tall and 40 mm wide. There are two 6 mm diameter holes in the base, centered 10 mm from each end along the length and centered across the width. There is one 6 mm diameter hole in the upright, centered 10 mm from the top and centered across the width. All holes are through-holes. The bracket must be watertight and match these dimensions within 0.5 mm."

user_request:
